name: COTE DIVOIRE
lead: Côte d'Ivoire means "Ivory Coast" in French. It is in West Africa. It grows nearly half the world's cocoa. Yamoussoukro is the official capital, but Abidjan runs the economy. Over 60 peoples live here and speak 75 languages.
geo: The land slopes from dry grassland in the north to thick rainforest in the south. Lagoons and fishing villages line the Atlantic coast.
The Nimba mountains in the far west rise to 1,752 m. This protected rainforest is shared with Guinea. Four big rivers cross the country's 322,460 km².
animals: The African forest elephant is the national animal. Taï National Park shelters leopards, bongo antelopes and western chimpanzees. Scientists have studied the chimps for 50 years.
The pygmy hippopotamus hides in Taï's streams. This forest hippo is the size of a large pig. It is one of Earth's rarest large mammals.
culture: Over 60 ethnic groups live in Côte d'Ivoire. Baoulé people make gold jewellery and wooden masks. Many believe Dan masks carry their own spirit.
Coupé-Décalé music was born in Abidjan. Maquis are open-air restaurants that serve smoky chicken with attiéké (cassava couscous). Aloko, fried plantain with chilli, is a favourite street snack.
history: Portuguese traders came in the 1400s. They named the shore after the ivory they bought. France made it a colony in 1893. Félix Houphouët-Boigny led peaceful independence in 1960.

His biggest monument is the Basilica (giant church) of Our Lady of Peace in Yamoussoukro. It was finished in 1989 and is bigger than St Peter's in Rome. The country rebuilt fast after civil war in the 2000s.
wows: Côte d'Ivoire grows about 45% of the world's cocoa, so nearly every chocolate bar starts here.
Abidjan is the world's 3rd-largest French-speaking city, after Kinshasa and Paris.
The Yamoussoukro basilica is the biggest church on Earth.
Yamoussoukro only became the official capital in 1983, but Abidjan still does most governing.
Taï chimps crack nuts with stone tools.
Since 1960, about 90% of the original rainforest has been cleared for farms.
The country has won the Africa Cup of Nations four times, most recently in 2024.

myths.myth: Cocoa beans taste like chocolate fresh from the tree
myths.fact: Fresh beans are bitter and pale. They must be fermented, dried and roasted first.
Chimps are apes, like us. Apes have no tail. Most monkeys do.
